title: Hunts FH-046: Attach separate approved donation ask

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 5, Fundraising. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Reuse Space donations checkout, receipts and authority. Separate benefactor consent and refund totals. Done when: Donation success, abandonment and full/partial refunds show correct settled totals and never change progression. Requires: FH-024, FH-040, FH-045. Owner role: Billing and CRM.
